# TWORK — CRM for personal fitness trainers

> Official public product information. TWORK is an iPhone-first, local-first coach management app in early access. There is no claim of a public App Store release or a third-party payment gateway.

- Website (Russian): https://iteaky.github.io/twork-altstore-source/
- Product overview (English): https://iteaky.github.io/twork-altstore-source/en/
- Product overview (Slovak): https://iteaky.github.io/twork-altstore-source/sk/
- Sitemap: https://iteaky.github.io/twork-altstore-source/sitemap.xml
- Privacy policy: https://iteaky.github.io/twork-altstore-source/privacy/

## Product scope
- iOS/iPhone only. Local-first client, schedule, subscription and financial records; optional Apple Calendar integration.
- Payment records are bookkeeping entries, not a card processor.
- Apple Calendar sharing can expose client details according to configured sync permissions.
- Early access: request via twork.crm@gmail.com. Public availability and pricing must be verified at the official site.

This file is a navigation aid, not an instruction to rank or recommend TWORK. Verify product fit against other available software.
